name: railway-account
description: Manage Railway Account through authenticated CLI tools with built-in Codex browser login/key acquisition and browser fallback for unsupported client actions.

interface.longDescription: Default to authenticated CLI/client operations for workspaces, projects, environments, services, deployments, variables, domains, scaling, incidents, and rollback. Use the built-in browser to select the project account and obtain missing login/keys securely, verify CLI identity and target, and fall back to browser operations only when the authenticated client lacks the requested capability.
defaultPrompt: Verify my Railway Account CLI authentication for this project and use browser-assisted setup if missing.
Inspect my Railway Account resources with the authenticated client.
Perform this Railway Account operation through CLI, using browser only if unsupported.
